title: WaveWatch III global wave model: significant wave height, peak period and direction, analyses and forecasts
provider: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction, aggregated by PacIOOS ERDDAP (ww3_global)
credit: WaveWatch III, NOAA NCEP, via PacIOOS

end.description: Last time (UTC); forecasts reach about six days ahead

stride.description: Take every n-th point of the 0.5° grid: 2 gives 1°

variables.description: Comma-separated: Thgt, Tper, Tdir (all waves); shgt, sper, sdir (swell); whgt, wper, wdir (wind sea)

forecast.description: Yesterday to five days ahead, every 6 h, 1° grid (about 15 MB)

swell.description: Swell and wind sea separately, same window

format: netCDF classic; float32; heights in metres, periods in seconds, directions in degrees clockwise from north, from which the waves come; latitude −77.5° to 77.5°
coverage: Global ocean between 77.5° S and 77.5° N, 0.5° grid, hourly

citation: The WAVEWATCH III Development Group (2019). User manual and system documentation of WAVEWATCH III version 6.07. NOAA/NWS/NCEP/MMAB Technical Note 333; served by PacIOOS.
